_meta.method: Aggregated from quest_board, adventure_summaries, world_narrative, dm_announcements
source_files: data/discord/quest_board.json (100 raw messages, Region: fields extracted from content)
_meta.notes: quest_board.json contains raw Discord messages, not pre-parsed quests. Region values were extracted manually from **Region:** fields in message content. Many region strings include sub-location prefixes (e.g. 'Sinnacar, Dalmond'), hex codes (e.g. 'H20'), or are freeform and ambiguous.

an underground lake in the middle of somewhere. HH
far North West of Hillspass village. Red zone, Hollow Highlands

hex_code_schema.note: Hex codes follow a [Region Letter][Number] pattern observed across quest posts and dm_announcements.
hex_code_schema.H_prefix: Hollow Highlands (H7, H8, H15, H20 confirmed; HH-prefix also used: HH6, HH15, HH20)
hex_code_schema.N_prefix: Hollow Highlands / Nonzfyr sub-zone (N1, N10 confirmed)
hex_code_schema.E_prefix: Esparithen (E44, E49, E50 from dm_announcements; E51 from quest_board; E9, E10, E14 from dm_announcements)

region_director_map.note: Cross-referenced from world_narrative.json authors_and_roles. Helps validate region assignments.

conformance_notes.region_field_format: No enforced format. Values range from clean canonical names ('Hollow Highlands') to compound strings ('Sinnacar, Dalmond'), hex-prefixed ('H20, Hollow Highlands'), freeform prose ('far North West of Hillspass village. Red zone, Hollow Highlands'), or missing entirely.
conformance_notes.sinnacar_dalmond_overlap: Sinnacar is a settlement within Dalmond, not a separate region. Reclassified from canonical region to Dalmond sub-location.
conformance_notes.pelsand_own_region: Pelsand declared its own region. Previously ambiguous between Dunnshore and Viceroc.
conformance_notes.gatehaven_felunia_reclassified: Gatehaven and Felunia had zero data presence in scraped files. Reclassified as Dalmond settlements, not separate regions.
conformance_notes.pawluck_esparithen_compound: Multiple quests list 'Pawluck, Esparithen' or 'Pawluck Valley, Esparithen' — Pawluck Valley appears to be geographically inside or bordering Esparithen per world_narrative regions_mentioned.
conformance_notes.songnest_status: Listed as its own region in world_narrative.json regions_mentioned ('Songnest: Region where Black Hole appeared') and in dm_announcements as a restricted zone. However, quest posts use 'Pawluck, Songsnest' suggesting it is a sub-location of Pawluck. Mapped to Pawluck pending confirmation.
conformance_notes.gatehaven_felunia_reclassified_note: Gatehaven and Felunia had zero data presence. Now classified as Dalmond settlements (Features), not canonical regions.
